def application(environ, start_response):
    status = "200 OK"
    body = b"Hello from Elastic Beanstalk, deployed by Terraform!"
    headers = [
        ("Content-Type", "text/plain"),
        ("Content-Length", str(len(body))),
    ]
    start_response(status, headers)
    return [body]

def application(environ, start_response):

environment_name.description: Logical environment name, e.g. dev, staging, prod.

environment_type.description: Elastic Beanstalk environment layout. Valid values: LoadBalanced, SingleInstance.

instance_type.description: EC2 instance type used by the Elastic Beanstalk environment.

project_name.description: Short project identifier used as the naming prefix for all resources.

solution_stack.description: Elastic Beanstalk platform (solution stack) for the environment.
